'''Swaine Lothar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], his team uncovered several artifacts in the [[Dark Temple]] and went insane.<ref name="TOR" />
